news.h: Sources: Ravens not expected to deal RB Derrick Henry before NFL trade deadline
news.d: Ravens running back Derrick Henry is not expected to be moved by the NFL trade deadline.

news.h: Jaguars thrash the depleted Ravens 33-10 for their 5th win in 6 games
news.d: — With their top two quarterbacks injured, the Baltimore Ravens were prepared to use any trick necessary in their attempt to keep the game competitive against Jacksonville. That included snapping the ball directly to Derrick Henry on quite a few...

news.h: Ravens' Derrick Henry moves into 7th place on NFL all-time rushing list
news.d: Derrick Henry passed LaDainian Tomlinson and moved into seventh on the NFL's all-time rushing list.
